verdict.rationale: Settling agent-initiated payments in stablecoins is a fair question for an agentic payments product, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack mentions stablecoins, crypto, or on-chain settlement rails. The documented flows cover tokenized shopper credentials (ACP/UCP tokens), Google Pay, and standard payment authorization, none of which is stablecoin settlement.

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails
